cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.

mechanism: A uses assumed authority over practice time to prioritize A's greater anxiety over B's.
confusable: Unlike ordinary one-upmanship, A reallocates the other person's requested help and decides the exercise.
comparison: Interview practice hijacking differs from the theatre consolation and listening request in b.
seedUse: The seed already assigns B to ask A questions and appropriates practice time, supplying a genuine S01 merger.
